description: This file defines a custom report class for generating product price and cost structure reports in an OpenERP (Odoo) module, including methods for processing bill of materials and work centers, and producing XML output.

classes.name: report_custom
classes.description: A custom report class for generating product price and cost structure reports, extending report_rml.

methods.name: create_xml
methods.description: Generates an XML report of product cost structure, including BOM and workcenter details.
